provenance.dimension_basis: OEM family dimensions; video-estimated bezel, liner mouth, sheet thickness and handle shape. Serial revision not legible.
provenance.hidden_structure: Sheet thickness, rail internals, counterbalance, latch linkage and rear service detail are visual engineering estimates, not recovered OEM internals.

review.method: Inspected final H264-decoded paired source/output samples at closed product, LCD/USB macro and open/moving door states. Full streams were decoded and counted; visual inspection is sampled, not every frame.
findings: Principal-model identity, door/controller arrangement and retained source-shot position agree with the chosen reconstruction.
Final cavity floor meets front opening; sampled moving shell and handle surfaces clear the cabinet.
Observed source LCD content stays inside native screen coordinates; no hands or cabinet texture used.
Source scene and overlays differ intentionally because all assets use the frozen Tangyuan kitchen.
limitations: Only principal microwave geometry and visible mechanical states are reconstructed. Source people, food, overlaid titles and editing transitions are omitted.
Camera landmark fits and interpolated source tracking remain estimates; per-frame source indices and native projection equivalence do not prove pixel-perfect visual reconstruction.
Hidden joints, seals, latches, wall thicknesses and unmeasured local dimensions are estimated; no force simulation or continuous-time collision certification.

Source pixels are limited to rectified approved visible LCD emission surfaces. All cabinet, door and controls are native geometry; occluded LCD states use native text or a reliable unchanged display state.
Source 613–696 is an edited cavity inset over a prior LCD shot; the physical cavity shot is reconstructed as one camera view. Tiny lineup instances use the principal HDC position only.

native_projection.method: bpy_extras world_to_camera_view for native LCD 3D corners versus per-source camera K/matrix used by material homography

source_specific_revision.principal: Amana HDC with top controller and left side-hinged glazed door
source_specific_revision.revision: Shortened rear door return and corrected hinge axis; sampled shell and handle clearance now has no surface intersections.
